title: 第九章 云台夜宴第十章 仙门都庇护你了你还想要什么
slug: 一统天下后方知此世有仙
content_zh:
云台夜宴，等待了许久的陆俊峰一行终于是等到了谢苍荣的召见，双方各有所求，也各有所好奇，都对这场会面期待已久。
行至皇城门前，那巍峨的宫阙仿佛直插墨色苍穹，一股无形的重压已然悄然笼罩肩头。月光清冷，映照着脚下层层石阶，向上延伸，没入灯火辉煌的殿宇深处，恍若登天之途。
陆俊峰喉头微动，轻轻呼出一口气：“我们走罢！”
一众修者在侍卫的带领下进了皇宫，走到那云台宴会之处，有阵阵轻灵美妙的乐声在耳边回荡，亦伴随着男子豪迈的说笑之声。
“吱呀~”
似乎是知晓陆俊峰一行到了，大殿大门缓缓开启。
一时间万籁俱寂，明亮之处，似有万千视线拥来。
陆俊峰知道最高处主位上有一人端坐，但是他的视线却只能看到对方的桌腿。
他微微低下头，跟随着侍者走上石阶，步入这煌煌殿堂。
他们是仙门弟子，在凡俗王朝的跟前是要维持住仙门的尊严和体面的。在鹤鸣洲，他们可以昂首挺胸，随意面见乃至于驱使君主。
然而到了这里，他们在安静的氛围中迎着所有人的视线走进大殿，却平白有种沉重之感压在心头，莫说是维持着作为超凡修士的骄傲，他就算是抬起头来，直视对面主座上的人都做不到。
眼睛余光扫过两旁，却是不由得瞳孔一缩。
左侧一个个将军豪迈喝酒吃肉，笑容爽朗，打量着他们。但落到陆俊峰的眼中，他们却都是气场凛冽的杀神修罗，血气冲天，摄人心魄。
一将功成万骨枯，这一群人的身后仿佛是一片无穷无尽的尸山血海。
而在另一侧，浩然之气升腾，形成了另一股威压。文臣同样也在打量着他们，他们职责不同，思想不同，性格不同，所以气势也截然不同，但是他们的目光澄澈如明镜一般，仿佛可以穿透皮囊，窥探人心底所想。
角落里，有一坐着轮椅，手中把玩着一个不知名的木头盒子的女子也饶有兴味地打量着他们，眼中光彩流转，满是好奇。
宁伯兴和宋兆文根本就不是个例！
这些人真是太诡异了！
承载着这些视线，每走一步，陆俊峰便觉步履愈发沉重。
他很清楚自己正面面对的是谁。

“使者，既见君主，为何不拜？”
在谢苍荣的身边不远处，柳秉玄出声，打破了寂静的氛围。
陆俊峰闻言浑身一震，恍惚抬头，直直看向谢苍荣，这一路被人反复提起的领袖。
年轻的君王映入眼帘。
他生得俊逸，着锦衣，戴冕旒，剑眉斜飞，冕旒珠玉轻晃间，双目深邃仿佛蕴藏浩瀚星河，此时正带着和煦的笑容，平静地注视着他，全无半点压迫感。
谢苍荣身上没有半点法力，他只是个凡人。
然而这一刻，透过谢苍荣的眼睛，陆俊峰却好像看到了那不可形容，不可名状之大恐惧，恍若万重山岳一般磅礴的压力扑面而来，天地倒悬，万法崩灭，日月山河的咆哮在他识海中炸响！
这样的感觉，他只在宗主的身上感受到过。
他们是仙门，是修士，追求的是天地造化，超脱万物。
来之前，他们已经做好了准备，要维持仙门的体面威仪，自不能像凡人一般对这君王毕恭毕敬。反倒要不卑不亢，于人前显圣，展现出自己的本领和力量。
然而此时此刻，面对着谢苍荣的目光，他的灵魂仿佛被那强大之势撞了一下，大脑一阵空白，原本想好的那些不卑不亢的言辞早已经忘之脑后。
content_en:
At the Yuntai night banquet, Lu Junfeng and his party, who had been waiting for a long time, finally waited for Xie Cangrong's summons. Both parties had their own needs and curiosity, and they had all been looking forward to this meeting for a long time.
Arriving in front of the imperial city gate, the majestic palace seemed to reach straight into the inky sky, and an invisible weight had quietly enveloped my shoulders. The cold moonlight reflects the stone steps beneath your feet, extending upwards and sinking into the depths of the brightly lit palace, making it seem like you are on your way to heaven.
Lu Junfeng's throat moved slightly and he breathed out softly: "Let's go!"
A group of cultivators entered the palace under the leadership of the guards and walked to the Yuntai banquet place. Waves of light and beautiful music echoed in their ears, accompanied by the heroic chatter and laughter of men.
"Squeak~"
As if knowing that Lu Junfeng and his party had arrived, the door of the hall slowly opened.
For a moment, everything was silent, and in the bright place, there seemed to be thousands of sights coming.
Lu Junfeng knew that there was a person sitting in the highest seat, but he could only see the other person's table legs.
He lowered his head slightly, followed the waiter up the stone steps, and entered the glorious palace.
They are disciples of the Immortal Sect, and they must maintain the dignity and respectability of the Immortal Sect in front of the mortal dynasty. In Hemingzhou, they can hold their heads high and meet and even command the monarch at will.
However, when they arrived here, they walked into the hall with everyone's eyes in a quiet atmosphere, but they felt a heavy feeling in their hearts. Not to mention maintaining the pride of being an extraordinary monk, he couldn't even raise his head and look directly at the people on the main seat opposite.
The peripheral vision of his eyes swept to both sides, but his pupils couldn't help but shrink.
On the left, the generals were drinking and eating meat boldly, looking at them with hearty smiles. But in Lu Junfeng's eyes, they were all Shura, the God of Killing with a fierce aura, whose blood was soaring and breathtaking.
After one general's success, tens of thousands of bones were withered, and behind this group of people there seemed to be an endless sea of ​​corpses and blood.
On the other side, awe-inspiring energy rose, forming another pressure. The civil servants were also looking at them. They had different responsibilities, different thoughts, and different personalities, so their auras were completely different. However, their eyes were as clear as a mirror, as if they could penetrate the skin and peer into the innermost thoughts of people's hearts.
In the corner, there was a woman sitting in a wheelchair and playing with an unknown wooden box in her hands. She was also looking at them with interest, her eyes shining with curiosity.
Ning Boxing and Song Zhaowen are not exceptions at all!
These people are so weird!
Carrying these gazes, Lu Junfeng felt that his steps became heavier with every step he took.
He knew exactly who he was facing.
"Messenger, since you have met your Majesty, why don't you worship him?"
Not far from Xie Cangrong, Liu Bingxuan spoke up, breaking the silent atmosphere.
Lu Junfeng was shocked when he heard this. He raised his head in a daze and looked straight at Xie Cangrong, the leader who had been mentioned repeatedly along the way.
The young king came into view.
He was handsome and handsome, wearing brocade clothes and a crown. His sword-shaped eyebrows flew sideways, and the crown jewels were swaying lightly. His eyes were as deep as if they contained vast galaxies. At this moment, he was looking at him calmly with a warm smile, without any sense of oppression.
Xie Cangrong has no magic power at all, he is just a mortal.
However, at this moment, through Xie Cangrong's eyes, Lu Junfeng seemed to see the indescribable, indescribable fear, the majestic pressure like ten thousand mountains rushing towards his face, the sky and the earth hanging upside down, everything collapsed, and the roar of the sun, moon, mountains and rivers exploded in his sea of ​​consciousness!
He had only felt this feeling from the sect master.
They are immortals and monks, pursuing the creation of heaven and earth and transcending all things.
Before coming, they had already made preparations. In order to maintain the dignity of the Immortal Sect, they could not respect the king like mortals. On the contrary, you should be neither humble nor arrogant, show your holiness in front of others, and show your abilities and strength.
However, at this moment, facing Xie Cangrong's eyes, his soul seemed to be overwhelmed by that powerful force.There was a moment of collision, and the mind went blank for a while, and the neither humble nor arrogant words that I had originally thought of had long been forgotten.
